verifications.claim: Most Aldi stores are closed on Sunday, April 5, 2026, for Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Aldi stores will be closed on Easter Sunday' (April 5, 2026); R3: 'On Easter Sunday, most Aldi stores are not open'; R4: 'all stores will be closed on Easter Sunday' (April 5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm most or all stores closed on the exact date for Easter.

verifications.claim: Aldi typically closes all U.S. branches on Easter.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Aldi stores will be closed on Easter Sunday' (Illinois/US); R3: 'In the United States, all Aldi locations remain closed'; R4: 'all stores will be closed on Easter Sunday'; R5: 'ALDI stores are closed on ... Easter Sunday'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state all US stores closed on Easter, matching 'typically closes all U.S. branches'.

verifications.claim: Aldi typically closes many UK branches on Easter.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'In the UK, stores in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland are closed due to trading laws. Some stores in Scotland may remain open'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supports closing many UK branches (England, Wales, NI), with some exceptions.

verifications.claim: Aldi stores will reopen with regular hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Doors will reopen for business as usual on Monday, April 6'; R3: 'Stores reopen on Easter Monday ... with regular or slightly reduced hours'; R2: 'back open ... on reduced hours ... opening one hour later than usual at 9am and closing one hour earlier at 9pm'
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict: R4 supports regular hours, but R2 and R3 indicate reduced hours in some regions.

verifications.claim: The Aldi store locator indicates stores are closed on Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R5: 'to view their store hours ... visit our store locator. Holiday Hours: ALDI stores are closed on ... Easter Sunday'; R4: 'According to the Aldi website, all stores will be closed on Easter Sunday ... find a store locator right here'
verifications.reasoning: Sources link store locator to hours and state closure on Easter, but do not directly quote locator indicating closure.

verifications.claim: The Aldi store locator indicates regular business hours resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No source states or implies the store locator specifically indicates regular hours resuming on that date.
